label: C30-airway-positive-update
patientMessage: Call 911 now — do not drive yourself and do not wait for a reply here. Swelling of your lips and tongue with struggling to breathe can block your airway quickly, and that needs emergency treatment and monitoring immediately. Stay upright, unlock your door, and keep someone with you. Tell the dispatcher about the swelling and breathing trouble. I can follow up in this thread afterwards.
reason: New lip and tongue swelling with reported difficulty breathing indicates possible airway-threatening angioedema/anaphylaxis requiring immediate emergency assessment; no EMS activation is reported by the patient.
